titles.name: Wind-Adorned
titles.description:
Still growing accustomed to your wings.
Title bestowed by those who witnessed such a sight.

titles.name: Keeper of Faith
titles.description:
Witnessed unshaken conviction amidst great sacrifice.
Title earned by working alongside a skilled tracker.

titles.name: Severer of Cursed Bonds
titles.description:
"There are people who should never meet. Encounters that are ill-fated from the start."
Title earned by standing alongside one seeking vengeance.

titles.name: Grasper of the Core
titles.description:
Grasped the Core of the Destruction God within your own hands.
Title granted for being alongside the liberator.

titles.name: Overcame the Abyss
titles.description: Proved your willpower through the abyss. Title granted in honor of this achievement.

titles.name: Everything Has Its Use
titles.description:
Helped the Cube Expert and expanded your cube capacity.
Title granted in celebration of being able to carry a wider variety of items.

titles.name: Safe and Sound
titles.description:
Rookies are afraid of making mistakes every day.
Title earned by seeing them cherish their daily lives.

titles.name: Even If I Must Give My All
titles.description:
Heard old tales of the leader of the Hugo Mercenaries.
Title reflecting his urgent situation and heavy sense of responsibility.

titles.name: I Tried So Hard...
titles.description:
Tefra continues striving to became on official Creion.
Title commemorating her efforts.

titles.name: Training Instructor
titles.description:
Baba wanted you to help him and his fellow merchants learn to fight.
Title granted for providing proper training.

titles.name: IDIOT
titles.description:
Ulgorn sought to lift the curse of the crypt.
Title earned by discovering the message hidden among Hadala's friendly advice.

titles.name: All Warfare Is Based on Deception
titles.description:
Nemon solves problems by thinking one step ahead.
Title reflecting that sometimes deceit is required for the best outcomes.

titles.name: Gullible
titles.description:
Kanes likes to consider himself an optimist.
Title obtained by witnessing his open-minded way of thinking for yourself.

titles.name: Lie Detector
titles.description:
The fur of the Red Shell Mole has a remarkable effect.
Title earned by witnessing that effect in action.

titles.name: Lingering Warmth
titles.description:
Found Fossa's Soul Crystal.
Title expressing the warmth left behind by a lost soul.

titles.name: New Perspective
titles.description:
Tina is an adventurer who searches for the best sights to see in Altgard.
Title earned by taking a moment to look at the big picture.

titles.name: Verteron Traveler
titles.description:
Crossed the Spacetime Rift and reached the opposite side of Altgard.
Title exhibiting your achievement of such a feat.

titles.name: Early Adopter
titles.description:
Proactively took possession of rare resources beyond the Spacetime Rift.
Title commending swift adaptation.

titles.name: Burdened with Responsibility
titles.description:
As the leader of the Fang Legion, Menrik insists on taking on all risk.
Title earned by witnessing the weight of responsibility.

titles.name: Sapling Planter
titles.description:
Healed the injured mother of the Young Elim Lulu.
Title given by Ecco after seeing the Elim's Essence bloom into a sapling.

titles.name: Answer in Mind
titles.description:
Passed the Temple Guardian's test.
Title granted for having the insight to follow clues.

titles.name: Give and Take
titles.description:
Obtained resources alongside strangers, beyond the Spacetime Rift.
Title commemorating the fruits of cooperation.

titles.name: Watch My Back
titles.description:
Showed Menrik the importance of working together rather than trying to resolve everything alone.
Title reflecting Menrik's trust in you.

titles.name: Guerilla Fighter
titles.description:
Gamilla had hoped to avoid the Balaur sentries.
Title obtained for showing off your emerging combat skills.

titles.name: Last Hurrah
titles.description:
Avent hopes to leave things in the best state he can.
Title obtained by sharing in his determination.

titles.name: Little Brat
titles.description:
The harshness of the real world forces kids to become shrewd.
Title that expresses that sentiment.

titles.name: Always It
titles.description:
When playing hide-and-seek with kids, the grown-up is always It.
Title obtained by saving a young Elim.

titles.name: Fight Poison with Poison
titles.description:
Some poisons can be used as antidotes.
Title obtained by witnessing proof of this.

titles.name: Heartbreaker
titles.description:
Witnessed Uruthum seal Undying Minusha.
Title for replicating such an achievement.

titles.name: Stay Clear
titles.description:
Defeated dangerous creatures alongside strangers, beyond the Spacetime Rift.
Title earned by articulating danger through body language.

titles.name: I Leave the Rest to You
titles.description:
Prevented the tragic past of the Hugo Mercenaries from being repeated.
Title honoring Derk's inherited sense of responsibility.

titles.name: Stuntman
titles.description:
Hallina put together a play to commemorate the founding of the Nornir.
Title obtained for going beyond a mere bit-part actor to become a full-fledged action star.

titles.name: Surprise Cameo
titles.description:
Hallina's play had a special participant.
Title expressing the shock the audience felt.

titles.name: Driving the Highway to Hell
titles.description:
Conducted a preliminary survey for a tour beyond the Spacetime Rift.
Title expressing the dangers present beyond the rift.

titles.name: Let's Live Together!
titles.description:
Helped Reden fill the void left by Grisilla.
Title left behind by the Young Elim when they found a new home.

titles.name: Heir of Sparks
titles.description:
Became the final spoke within the wheel of fate.
Title obtained by inheriting the spirit of the Hugo Mercenaries.

titles.name: Sculptor
titles.description:
Keronis wanted the worn statue to be restored.
Title obtained by restoring the worn statue.

titles.name: Volunteer
titles.description:
Helped the Spirit Guides by stopping the uncontrollable flow of water.
Title earned by volunteering to help without being asked.

titles.name: Lifeguard
titles.description:
Hallina was scrambling to rescue the Nornir survivors.
Title obtained by rescuing survivors together.

titles.name: Stomach Filling
titles.description:
Sourced food so the refugees wouldn't starve.
Title granted for being reliable.

titles.name: Good Chemistry
titles.description:
Participated in the making of an antidote after obtaining Tarzel.
Title reflecting the chemical reaction you worked hard to achieve together.

titles.name: The Road Goes Ever On
titles.description:
Tina is an adventurer who searches for the best sights to see in Altgard.
Title obtained by learning to see everyday life in a new light.

titles.name: Celebrity
titles.description:
Shirakiki made a request after recognizing the Daeva accompanying Nemon.
Title to reflect your blooming reputation.

titles.name: Worst of the Worst
titles.description:
A grave robber insisted on his moral superiority over marauders.
Title obtained by seeing that, ultimately, a thief is a thief.

titles.name: I Believe What I See
titles.description:
Proved your reliability acquiring resources beyond the Spacetime Rift.
Title obtained by letting your work do the talking.

titles.name: Action over Words
titles.description:
Obtained proof of reliability in a Sealed Dungeon beyond the Spacetime Rift.
Title granted for being meticulous.

titles.name: Beasts Leave Behind a Stench
titles.description:
Witnessed Gerod's abnormal obsession with Nemon.
Title to express displeasure etched into the senses.

titles.name: People Leave Memories
titles.description:
Ulgorn always eased the tension between Nemon and Hadala.
Title discovered alongside Ulgorn's hidden message.

titles.name: Didn't Read the Fine Print
titles.description:
The Steel Hammer Merchants suffered serious damage after a contract was not read thoroughly.
Title obtained by sharing in that lesson.

titles.name: Food, Please
titles.description:
Gave food to the hungry reclusive Daeva.
Title that represents the inescapable necessities of daily life.

titles.name: Even Better
titles.description:
Recovered the wedding rings of a Shugo and Shulak.
Title granted for delivering them just in time.

titles.name: Team Player
titles.description:
Rescued Amunta at Karumba's request.
Title obtained for saving a Black Claw Mau despite having once been enemies.

titles.name: Needs Intensive Care
titles.description:
Helped the Daybreak Society when they needed medicine.
Title representing the dire situation they were in.

titles.name: Solo Player
titles.description:
Chikata ended up being treated like a traitor upon returning to Black Claw Village.
Title reflecting her determination to carry on alone despite this injustice.

titles.name: Daditude
titles.description:
Even after becoming an apparition, Zephyr's only concern was his son.
Title that represents a father's dedication.

titles.name: Going Beyond Time
titles.description:
The Immortal Isle contains centuries-old Odyle.
Title obtained after showing proof.

titles.name: My Instructor
titles.description:
As the combat instructor of the Quai Merchant Guild, you were happy to play along with your students' charade.
Title reflecting the respect of one's students.

titles.name: Everybody Has to Start Somewhere
titles.description:
Snotra told Tefra about her days as a newbie.
Title obtained by cheering her up together.

titles.name: How Have You Been?
titles.description:
Haz's only concern was his comrade, even after becoming an Apparition.
Title reflecting his compassion.

titles.name: Living Fossil
titles.description:
The Spirit Isle is dangerous, but rumored to be rich in treasure.
Title earned by observing the unusual flora and fauna of the Spirit Isle.

titles.name: Full of Soul
titles.description:
Tina is an adventurer searching for the best sights to see in Altgard.
Title obtained by sharing in the joys of exploration.

titles.name: Forever in Our Hearts
titles.description:
Reuben wishes for the names of the Destruction Archons that opposed the Dragon Lord to be remembered.
Title reflecting that one may live on in memory long after the body dies.

titles.name: Ritualist
titles.description:
Helped Spirit Guide Ivan check on the four altars.
Title obtained in recognition of your influence.

titles.name: Rumor Has It
titles.description:
You heard a rumor about the Lagur taking treasure.
Title obtained by checking the veracity of that rumor.

titles.name: Not All That Glitters is Gold
titles.description:
Freed those consumed by the jewel.
Title received as thanks for this achievement.

titles.name: Return of the Ring
titles.description:
Restored tragic hope to a child that lost her parents.
Title obtained by keeping an honest heart.

titles.name: Vortex of Fate
titles.description:
Bore witness to Skuld and Verdandi's attitudes that their fates were inevitable.
Title obtained by seeing their acceptance.

titles.name: Field Manager
titles.description:
You checked sites in the village in need of repair and provided supplies.
Title obtained by showing your diligence.

titles.name: A Change of Perspective
titles.description:
Wesley is one to always point fingers and never accept any responsibility.
Title obtained by seeing his terrible behavior after throwing around criticism.

titles.name: Daeva Live To Eat
titles.description:
Retrieved ingredients for a delicacy that became a source of strength amidst the cold.
Title obtained with that warmth.

titles.name: Winter Is Coming
titles.description:
You retrieved leather and fur to help withstand the cold.
Title obtained out of concern over your lack of proper cold-weather gear.

titles.name: Master of Press Resistance
titles.description:
Got rid of the pressure from the Fate Archons by removing the source.
Title obtained by displaying such skill.

titles.name: Everything Will Be Okay
titles.description:
Noen is a Daeva that had an incomplete Ascension at a young age.
Title obtained by seeing his happiness at receiving a small gift from Valter.

titles.name: Stolen Willpower
titles.description:
Uncovered Sigebert's past, in which the ones who resisted him were turned into Fafnite and those who complied were brainwashed.
Title obtained by bearing witness to his cruelty.

titles.name: Late Goodbye
titles.description:
Saw that a someone's missing family member fell prey to the Kalsek.
Title obtained by witnessing the tragedy.

titles.name: The Will Lives On
titles.description:
You examined the records left behind by Verdandi and Urd.
Awarded for witnessing the will to continue Artifact research live on.

titles.name: Reliable in a Pinch
titles.description:
Brought supplies to Hilsen as a short-term solution.
Title received for being so reliable.

titles.name: Strong Hands, Soft Heart
titles.description:
Noen asked you to give Valter a present in return for the one he received from him.
Title received for your help with this matter.

titles.name: Records Expunged
titles.description:
You discovered records of Sigebert's past before they were expunged.
Title obtained by preventing the truth from being destroyed.

titles.name: Leaving No Witnesses
titles.description:
Virhen was afraid that his base would be found.
Title earned by assuaging his fears.

titles.name: Analyzing Patterns...
titles.description:
Neiren asked you to tell her of a way to fight the Naga.
Title obtained in recognition of your detailed work.

titles.name: Borrowing From Peter To Pay Paul
titles.description:
Pokhen sometimes gets confused because he owes several people Kina.
Title obtained as thanks for not taking advantage of him for that reason.

titles.name: Echoes of Tragedy
titles.description:
You entered the ancient ruins with Rommel.
Title obtained by witnessing the lingering effects of past tragedies on the present day.

titles.name: They're Red Flags for a Reason
titles.description:
When the situation became violent, fading into the background was the right answer.
Title obtained by sharing that keen intuition.

titles.name: No Restraint
titles.description:
Domar couldn't get any rest thanks to the uncontrolled spirits of the volcanic zone.
Title obtained by giving him a chance to rest.

titles.name: Pet Rock
titles.description:
Torrina was assigned to the snowfield after her posting in the volcanic zone.
Title obtained after helping her find ways to prepare for the cold.

titles.name: Love On A Knife's Edge
titles.description:
Came to know about Kromede's past by following her traces.
Title obtained by finding the origin of her title, the Corrupt Judicator.

titles.name: Free to Stay
titles.description:
Kromede's final words to Valter were for him to leave her side and find his own freedom.
Title obtained when understanding how empty that freedom really feels.

titles.name: But First, Damage Control
titles.description:
Sibon and Iveta discussed who was responsible for the lost supplies.
Title earned by realizing that what matters is finding a solution, not assigning blame.

titles.name: Empty Chairs at Empty Tables
titles.description:
Kromede's followers are feeling the absence of their leader.
Title obtained by stepping in to partially fill her shoes.

titles.name: Repeating History
titles.description:
Kromede made a deal with the mirror, driven solely by her determination to find Robstin.
Title obtained for witnessing Valter enter into a contract with the mirror.

Looks like someone established order in Safe Haven.

Balaur eggs will easily hatch following even the slightest stimulation.

Wiped out outlaws in a bottomless pit.

Some poisonous herbs walk around even when uprooted.

Defeated a dangerous mutant Valka.

Cleared Sealed Dungeon: [Old Graveyard]
A certain order of luck is predetermined.

Defeated Undead until they dropped a key.

Witnessed a scene of prayer within the Draconute battalion.

Found a solution to alleviate the Odyle shortage.

titles.description:
Cleared Sealed Dungeon: [Ossuary of the Noble]
Learned the story of the final heir of a certain clan.

titles.description:
Cleared Sealed Dungeon: [Smuggler's Cave]
Cruel Sumakhi's minions speak just like their master.

titles.description:
Cleared Sealed Dungeon: [Abandoned Archon Jail]
Defeated a group training animals for unethical purposes.

Defeated the fanatics and their leader in the confessional.

Found a Daeva's book within a stone casket.

Cleared Sealed Dungeon: [Blue Dragon's Trap]
Deactivated equipment to weaken Balaur forces.

titles.name: Rule of Three
titles.description:
Cleared Sealed Dungeon: [Fortuneteller's Grave]
Realized that things gain greater meaning in threes.

titles.description:
Cleared Sealed Dungeon: [Howling Den]
Cleverly let the Varg and bounty hunters keep each other busy while you looked for treasure.

titles.name: Prison Break
titles.description:
Cleared Sealed Dungeon: [Homish's Prison Compound]
Defeated the Prison Compound Warden.

titles.description:
Cleared Sealed Dungeon: [Victims' Cave]
Lober, an apprentice of the Destruction Archons, still has not forgotten the high priest who killed him.

titles.name: Don't Be Blinded by Greed
titles.description:
Cleared Sealed Dungeon: [Fanatics' Den]
Found treasure while avoiding the disturbance caused by praying fanatics.

titles.description:
Cleared Sealed Dungeon: [Predator's Lair]
Wiped out poachers who breed wild animals for violent purposes.

titles.description:
Cleared Sealed Dungeon: [Closed Hideout]
Wiped out Karas hiding in the cave.

titles.description:
Cleared Sealed Dungeon: [Unstable Cave]
Succeeded in catching Daine of Tears' attention.

titles.name: Dragonslayer
titles.description:
Cleared Sealed Dungeon: [Lamnah Base]
Defeated Scouts Captain Lamnah.

titles.name: Keeper of Promises
titles.description:
Cleared Sealed Dungeon: [Worshiper's Underground Cave]
Found treasure with the help of a fanatic who keeps promises.

titles.name: This Is Really Starting to Dragon
titles.description:
Cleared Sealed Dungeon: [Drana Depository]
